workflow.posSoundsHelp: Sounds for incoming orders, kiosk notifications and kitchen updates. Visual alerts stay active.
workflow.audioSaveFailed: Could not save the sound setting.
workflow.windowsDeviceHelp: Windows manages monitor brightness, speakers, pointer and touch feedback, and screen sleep. Open the relevant page to adjust this device.
workflow.configHealthyHelp: This till has a recent settings snapshot. Orders and device connections have their own status.
workflow.configUnknownHelp: The settings status is not available yet. You can refresh it below.
workflow.configProblemHelp: Refresh settings below. If this fails, open Connection and check the connection details with your administrator.
workflow.sessionHelp: The POS requires your PIN again when the authenticated session expires.
workflow.sessionLimits: This version uses a 30-minute inactivity limit and a maximum session duration of 2 hours. Custom auto-lock timing is not available.
workflow.sessionShift: Signing in again does not close the active shift. Windows screen sleep is configured separately under Screen & Sound.
workflow.hardwareHelp: Save connection details, then connect each device. Saving alone does not connect hardware.
workflow.hardwareSaved: Device settings saved. Use Connect to apply them to each device.
workflow.hardwareUnknown: Device status is unavailable. Refresh to check the connection.
workflow.unsupportedMsr: Magnetic card readers are not supported by this version. Use Card Machines for card payments.
workflow.capabilitiesHelp: Permissions and available areas are managed by your administrator.
workflow.unsavedHelp: Device connection details have not been saved. Save them before leaving, or discard your changes.
workflow.saveFailed: Could not save this setting. Please try again.
workflow.loyaltyInputHelp: For readers that type the card number like a keyboard. Running means the input listener is active; it does not confirm that an NFC device is connected.
workflow.copyFailed: Could not copy device information. Please try again.
workflow.deviceUnreachable: Device did not respond to the connection test
workflow.deviceLoadFailed: Could not read saved device settings. Retry before changing device connections.
workflow.cashConnectionHelp: A test checks reachability only. Connect the saved device before test printing. Reconnect after changing its settings.
workflow.callerRefreshFailed: Could not refresh Caller ID status. Check the details below.
workflow.callerStatusFailed: Local Caller ID status is unavailable. Refresh to check again.
